title: Jesus... I Can't Afford The Ticket Home This Year 🚆
topic: trains are full and flight fares cost three months of his savings, so he can't afford to go home for Diwali and is ashamed to tell his Amma

bible.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... trains are full and flight tickets cost three months of my savings. 🚆

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Waitlist 84. I stopped checking. Amma already asked which day I'm coming.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not failing home by staying. Home is people, not a berth.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But she'll say don't waste money, and it'll sound like pity.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That's her love talking. Call her anyway. Let the video call be your seat at the table this year.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Show up in the ways you can. Presence isn't only travel.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What would you do with one free trip home? 👇
